sources.authors: Ochsner KN, Bunge SA, Gross JJ, Gabrieli JDE
sources.title: Rethinking feelings: an fMRI study of the cognitive regulation of emotion
sources.used_for: 认知重评 fMRI 基础实验；前额叶激活↑、杏仁核激活↓
sources.key_finding: 重评时外侧+内侧PFC激活，双侧杏仁核和mOFC激活减少

sources.title: For better or for worse: neural systems supporting the cognitive down- and up-regulation of negative emotion
sources.used_for: 情绪调节的双向性（上调和下调）神经回路
sources.key_finding: 上调和下调均涉及PFC，但方向不同；杏仁核活动按调节目标方向改变

sources.title: Cognitive reappraisal of emotion: a meta-analysis of human neuroimaging studies
sources.used_for: 48项研究元分析，确定重评最稳健激活区
sources.key_finding: 外侧PFC（vlPFC/dlPFC）+语义区激活稳定；vmPFC不是稳定激活区；杏仁核减少

sources.title: TMS-fMRI reveals vlPFC→vmPFC→amygdala reappraisal circuit
sources.used_for: TMS 因果干预确认 vlPFC→vmPFC→杏仁核三层级回路
sources.key_finding: vlPFC TMS → vmPFC激活增加 + 杏仁核/岛叶激活减少

sources.title: Dynamic causal modelling identifies vmPFC→amygdala inhibitory effective connectivity during reappraisal
sources.used_for: 动态因果模型量化vmPFC→杏仁核负向有效连接
sources.key_finding: vmPFC是将前额叶控制转化为边缘系统抑制的主通道

sources.title: The Role of the Medial Prefrontal Cortex in the Conditioning and Extinction of Fear
sources.used_for: PL vs IL双分离功能综述；连接到杏仁核亚核的解剖
sources.key_finding: PL→恐惧表达；IL→消退表达；吻侧BLA→PL，尾侧BLA→IL

sources.title: Dissociable roles of prelimbic and infralimbic cortices, ventral hippocampus, and basolateral amygydala in the expression and extinction of conditioned fear
sources.used_for: IL灭活损害消退学习即时效果，PL灭活减弱恐惧表达（双分离）
sources.key_finding: IL灭活→消退获得受损；PL灭活→恐惧表达减弱

sources.authors: Mavrych V, Riyas F, Bolgova O
sources.title: The Role of Basolateral Amygdala and Medial Prefrontal Cortex in Fear: A Systematic Review
sources.used_for: BLA-mPFC连接的系统综述；分区投射细节
sources.key_finding: 吻侧BLA→PL；尾侧BLA→IL；PL促进恐惧，IL促进消退

sources.title: Prefrontal cortical-amygdalar metabolism in major depression
sources.journal: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences
sources.used_for: sgACC代谢过度活跃+灰质减少在家族性抑郁症中的早期证据
sources.key_finding: sgACC/BA25代谢↑+灰质体积↓；杏仁核发作期活动↑

sources.authors: Drevets WC, Bogers W, Raichle ME
sources.title: Functional anatomical correlates of antidepressant drug treatment assessed using PET measures of regional glucose metabolism
sources.used_for: 抗抑郁药缓解→sgACC代谢选择性降低，与临床改善相关
sources.key_finding: 治疗有效者右侧sgACC代谢↓，与HAMD改善相关

sources.title: Imaging phenotypes of major depressive disorder: genetic correlates
sources.used_for: sgACC高代谢和灰质减少作为抑郁症影像学表现型的遗传关联
sources.key_finding: sgACC高代谢+灰质减少是广泛重复的MDD影像表现型

sources.authors: Drevets WC, Price JL, Furey ML
sources.title: Brain structural and functional abnormalities in mood disorders: implications for neurocircuitry models of depression
sources.used_for: 情绪障碍神经回路综述；mPFC-杏仁核-海马-基底核回路
sources.key_finding: mPFC+杏仁核+海马+基底核灰质和代谢异常；MPFC调控自主神经和神经内分泌

sources.title: Neurocircuitry of mood disorders
sources.used_for: sgACC作为内脏运动皮层的框架；投射靶标（LC/DRN/PAG/下丘脑/NAc）
sources.key_finding: 内侧PFC连接杏仁核、腹侧纹状体-苍白球、内侧丘脑、下丘脑和PAG；sgACC=内脏运动皮层

sources.authors: Mayberg HS, Lozano AM, Voon V et al.
sources.title: Deep brain stimulation for treatment-resistant depression
sources.used_for: sgACC DBS先驱实验；6例TRD患者；4/6实现缓解
sources.key_finding: 慢性DBS靶向BA25旁白质纤维→sgACC代谢↓+前额叶代谢↑→抑郁缓解

sources.authors: Giacobbe P, Rizvi SJ, Ceniti AK et al.
sources.title: Long-term outcomes of deep brain stimulation of the subgenual cingulate gyrus for treatment-resistant depression: randomized controlled trial
sources.used_for: 最大单中心sgACC DBS RCT；RCT阶段无显著差异；开放标签24个月73.1%反应率
sources.key_finding: RCT阶段主动vs假刺激无显著差异（安慰剂难题）；开放延续73.1%反应率；安全性良好

coverage_assessment: 核心知识（认知重评回路、恐惧消退IL/PL回路、sgACC在抑郁症中的角色、DBS证据）有完整来源覆盖；主要文献限制：Ochsner 2002/2004、Buhle 2014元分析、Mayberg 2005 DBS先驱实验均为摘要。
